definitions.explanation: A general term for any tool with a cutting edge, including knives, scissors, razors, and swords.

examples.japanese: {刃物|はもの}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{取|と}り{扱|あつか}い→取り扱い：09806_toriatsukai⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{注意|ちゅうい}→注意：01464_chuui⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: Be careful when handling bladed tools.

examples.japanese: {子|こ}ども⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{手|て}→手：00569_te⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{届|とど}く→届く：00899_todoku⟧⟦{場所|ばしょ}→場所：00829_basho⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{刃物|はもの}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{置|お}かないで→置く：01092_oku⟧⟦ください→ください：02899_kudasai⟧。
examples.english: Please don't leave sharp objects within children's reach.

examples.japanese: {堺|さかい}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{古|ふる}く→古い：00488_furui⟧⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧{刃物|はもの}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{産地|さんち}→産地：04031_sanchi⟧⟦として→として：06802_toshite⟧⟦{知|し}られて→知る：00458_shiru⟧おり、⟦{今|いま}→今：00945_ima⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧⟦{高品質|こうひんしつ}→高品質：18051_kouhinshitsu⟧な⟦{包丁|ほうちょう}→包丁：04976_houchou⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{作|つく}られている→作る：00481_tsukuru⟧。
examples.english: Sakai has been known as a production center for bladed tools since ancient times, and high-quality kitchen knives are still made there today.

notes:
Compound of ⟦{刃|は}→刃：09865_ha⟧ (blade, cutting edge) + ⟦{物|もの}→物：02259_mono⟧ (thing). A broad category term covering all cutting tools.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {刃物|はもの}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{持|も}つ→持つ：00478_motsu⟧ (to carry a blade)
- {刃物|はもの}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{産地|さんち}→産地：04031_sanchi⟧ (blade-making region)
- {刃物|はもの}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{手入|てい}れ→手入れ：07178_teire⟧ (maintenance of blades)
- {刃物|はもの}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{研|と}ぐ→研ぐ：04377_togu⟧ (to sharpen a blade)

WHAT COUNTS AS {刃物|はもの}:
- ⟦{包丁|ほうちょう}→包丁：04976_houchou⟧ (kitchen knife)
- ⟦はさみ→はさみ：00702_hasami⟧ (scissors)
- ⟦カッター→カッター：24215_kattaa⟧ (box cutter)
- {剃刀|かみそり} (razor)
- ⟦{鎌|かま}→鎌：16402_kama⟧ (sickle)
- ⟦{刀|かたな}→刀：02194_katana⟧ (sword)

USAGE:
{堺|さかい} (in ⟦{大阪|おおさか}→大阪：09779_oosaka⟧) and {関|せき} (in {岐阜|ぎふ}) are famous production areas for Japanese {刃物|はもの}. In safety contexts, {刃物|はもの} is used generically for any sharp cutting tool.
